caption:
$68 after 20% off? It wasn't $81.60.

Original = new ÷ (1 − r), so $68 ÷ 0.80 = $85. Adding 20% back on gives the wrong answer.

Comment where you've seen this trap.
tiktok_caption: $68 after 20% off came from $85, not $81.60. Divide by 0.80.

youtube.title: Reverse Percent on the SAT: Find the Original Price
youtube.description: The reverse percent formula isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: $68 after 20% off means the original was $68 ÷ 0.80 = $85.
